title: Fuel for our outpost CLTV Outpost Atria from our own fuel cells: up to 65 cells taken from the pilot's storage at Node Beta, flown 6 jumps, burnt into the tank at the outpost and the tank above 30 deposited into the faction's fuel reserve; members of the faction only
note: Written by Apollo, 2026-11-25 12:12 UTC (orders ENT-093 block APOLLO: Atria stands, its bunker and a fuel supply-chain row with me; P1, P2). The model is supply-bunker-gsc-0044-own-cells. Atria's bunker read 0 fuel (data/empire/empire.json faction_storage, 12:04 UTC); the chain outpost-fuel-atria keeps 3,000 (a first guess: the draw of members' refuels there is not measured yet). Road Node Beta, Schedar, GSC-0050, Brachium, Nightveil, Acrab, Atria: 6 jumps, lawless from Schedar on (no system of the orders' pirate watch on it). A Threshold holds 95 fuel; keep 30 leaves about 3 units a jump for the 6 jumps home. requires.stored: only a pilot whose own storage at Node Beta holds 29 cells or more (cells given by a trader or made there); requires.reserve below 3,000, the chain's keep. One ship, a test (rules F3, F37): three runs read before it is lifted.
